+    /**

+    getCodeAtPosition(clientX, clientY, timeSeries, codes) {

+        const rect = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

+        // Helper: Distance from point p to segment v-w

+  static _groupCodes(codes) {
+    const groups = { b: [], s: [], d: [], e: [] };
+    codes.forEach(code => {
+        const prefix = code.charAt(0).toLowerCase();
+        if (groups[prefix]) groups[prefix].push(code);
+        else {
+             if (!groups['other']) groups['other'] = [];
+             groups['other'].push(code);
+        }
+    });
+    return groups;
+  }
+
+  static _generateColor(code) {
+    // FNV-1a Hash
+    let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
+    for (let i = 0; i < code.length; i++) {
+        hash ^= code.charCodeAt(i);
+        hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193);
+    }
+    // Mix to HSL
+    // Hue: 0-360 (full range)
+    // Saturation: 60-90% (avoid dull)
+    // Lightness: 40-70% (avoid white/black, keep readable)
+    const h = Math.abs(hash) % 360;
+    const s = 60 + (Math.abs(hash >> 8) % 30); 
+    const l = 40 + (Math.abs(hash >> 16) % 30);
+    return `hsl(${h}, ${s}%, ${l}%)`;
+  }

+
+/* --- Timeline View Specifics --- */
+
+.timeline-flex-container {
+  display: flex;
+  gap: 1rem;
+  height: 100%;
+  min-height: 400px;
+}
+
+.timeline-controls-panel {
+  width: 260px;
+  flex-shrink: 0;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  gap: 0.5rem;
+  overflow-y: auto;
+  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
+  padding-right: 0.5rem;
+  max-height: 600px;
+}
+
+.timeline-chart-panel {
+  flex: 1;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  position: relative;
+  min-width: 0;
+}
+
+.timeline-actions-row {
+  display: flex;
+  gap: 0.5rem;
+  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
+}
+
+.timeline-action-btn {
+  font-size: 0.8rem;
+  padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
+  flex: 1;
+}
+
+.timeline-section-header {
+  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
+}
+
+.timeline-group {
+  margin-top: 0.75rem;
+}
+
+.timeline-group-header {
+  font-size: 0.85rem;
+  font-weight: bold;
+  color: var(--text-secondary);
+  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: center;
+  padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
+  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
+  gap: 0.5rem;
+}
+
+.timeline-master-checkbox {
+  cursor: pointer;
+}
+
+.timeline-code-row {
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: center;
+  gap: 0.5rem;
+  font-size: 0.85rem;
+  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  padding: 0.1rem 0.2rem; /* slightly more padding horizontal */
+  border-radius: 4px; /* for highlight bg */
+}
+
+.timeline-code-row:hover {
+  background: var(--bg-hover);
+}
+
+.timeline-code-row.highlighted {
+  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
+  font-weight: bold;
+  color: var(--text-primary);
+}
+
+.timeline-color-box {
+  display: inline-block;
+  width: 10px;
+  height: 10px;
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  flex-shrink: 0;
+}
+
